# PDF.js viewer

Mozilla PDF.js 6.4.299, legacy distribution, Apache-2.0.

Source: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/releases/tag/v6.4.299

All upstream license files are retained. Sample PDFs and development source maps are excluded. Six ASCII letters in embedded worker string literals use equivalent Unicode escapes for package text hygiene; the JavaScript parser verifies identical decoded strings. Module files and their references use .js extensions so standard web servers serve JavaScript MIME types; ES module semantics are retained. Reproduce with `python3 tools/vendor-pdfjs.py /path/to/pdfjs-6.4.299-legacy-dist.zip`.
